<description>
`AnalyzePSBT` computes `fee = in_amt - out_amt` once every input amount is known and returns it as is. A PSBT whose outputs are worth more than its inputs therefore gets a negative `fee` and a `next` role of updater, even though no wallet can ever sign it into a valid transaction. The function already returns `PSBT is not valid. ...` for bad input values, unspendable outputs and an out-of-range output total.

An output total above the input total is reported the same way:

```
before: {"fee": -1.00000000, "next": "updater", ...}
after:  {"next": "creator", "error": "PSBT is not valid. Output amount larger than input amount"}
```

The functional test builds a PSBT that spends a 1 BTC output into a 2 BTC output and checks the error and the `creator` role. Without the change the assertion on `next` fails. `rpc_psbt.py`, `wallet_send.py`, `wallet_multisig_descriptor_psbt.py`, `rpc_openrpc.py` and the psbt unit tests pass.
</description>

<commits>
8262933013 psbt: analyzepsbt reports an error when outputs exceed inputs

When every input amount is known, AnalyzePSBT computed fee as
in_amt - out_amt and returned it even if it was negative, together with
a negative fee rate and a next role of updater or signer. Treat a PSBT
that pays out more than it spends as invalid, like the other amount
checks in the same function.
</commits>

<patch>
diff --git a/src/node/psbt.cpp b/src/node/psbt.cpp
index b0988d8682..972d5c30d7 100644
--- a/src/node/psbt.cpp
+++ b/src/node/psbt.cpp
@@ -119,6 +119,11 @@ PSBTAnalysis AnalyzePSBT(PartiallySignedTransaction psbtx)
             return result;
         }
 
+        if (out_amt > in_amt) {
+            result.SetInvalid("PSBT is not valid. Output amount larger than input amount");
+            return result;
+        }
+
         // Get the fee
         CAmount fee = in_amt - out_amt;
         result.fee = fee;
diff --git a/test/functional/rpc_psbt.py b/test/functional/rpc_psbt.py
index a92ca92f78..7c5e036505 100755
--- a/test/functional/rpc_psbt.py
+++ b/test/functional/rpc_psbt.py
@@ -1526,6 +1526,14 @@ class PSBTTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
         assert_equal(analysis['next'], 'creator')
         assert_equal(analysis['error'], 'PSBT is not valid. Output amount invalid')
 
+        self.log.info("PSBT whose outputs exceed its inputs should have error message and Creator as next")
+        overspend_utxo = self.create_outpoints(self.nodes[0], outputs=[{self.nodes[0].getnewaddress(): 1}])[0]
+        self.generate(self.nodes[0], 1)
+        overspend = self.nodes[0].createpsbt([overspend_utxo], [{self.nodes[0].getnewaddress(): 2}], psbt_version=0)
+        analysis = self.nodes[0].analyzepsbt(self.nodes[0].utxoupdatepsbt(overspend))
+        assert_equal(analysis['next'], 'creator')
+        assert_equal(analysis['error'], 'PSBT is not valid. Output amount larger than input amount')
+
         assert_raises_rpc_error(-22, "TX decode failed", self.nodes[0].analyzepsbt, "")
 
         assert_raises_rpc_error(-22, "TX decode failed", self.nodes[0].walletprocesspsbt, "")

</patch>
